title: Talk to an estate attorney
plain_summary: Some situations need an attorney's advice, not a checklist. An estate attorney can explain what applies to your family. Cairn will keep showing you the other steps it can help with.
attorney_referral_note: Cairn can't give legal advice and isn't a substitute for an attorney. An estate attorney can tell you what applies in your state.

citations.authority_name: Internal Revenue Service, Publication 559, Survivors, Executors, and Administrators
